policy: A certified block passes all three bars in scripts/certify_block.py. Control-delete (bar 3) is the one that counts: the block's tests must go RED when its entry method is gutted to a plausible success. New certifications must name a real fixture exercised by the tests. include_in_ci entries run on every CI push.

blocks.note: Certified 2026-09-20 on the entry point. CAVEAT: tests/blocks/test_clash_resolver.py (374 lines: mutation probe on the fall guard, batch rollback, exhausted-search escalation) is behind a module-level pytest.importorskip('trimesh') and trimesh was in no requirements file, so it skipped everywhere and pytest exited 5 on that path alone. trimesh==4.12.2 is now pinned in requirements.txt + requirements.lock but has NOT been installed or run here (the shared .venv must not be modified), so those tests are still unverified on this machine. The entry-point file deliberately needs no geometry backend -- its elements carry mesh=None so _would_create_new_clash returns before importing geometry_engine -- and covers the gravity fall constraint, the candidate-set ordering, the flagged-vs-proposed distinction and both advertised refusals.
